data.cultural_impact: Avraham is a significant cultural figure in Judaism and Christianity. In Jewish tradition, he is regarded as the founding patriarch of the Jewish people and the ancestor of the twelve tribes of Israel. In Christianity, Avraham is considered the father of faith and a model of obedience and devotion to God.
data.spiritual_significance: For Jews, Avraham represents the godly patriarch who embodied the qualities of faith and obedience to God's call. For Christians, Avraham is considered a model of faith and an ancestor of the Christian faith. In both traditions, Avraham's unwavering faith and his covenant with God serve as powerful spiritual examples and symbols of the eternal bond between God and His people.

seo.title: Avraham - Father of Many in Christianity
seo.meta_description: Discover the meaning, history, and significance of the Christian name Avraham. Learn about its cultural and religious usage and appeal as a name for boys.
seo.description_paragraph: Avraham is a Hebrew name with deep roots in both Judaism and Christianity. This name, which translates to 'father of many', has a rich history and is considered a symbol of faith and obedience to God. In the Hebrew Bible, Avraham is the patriarch of the Jewish people and is revered for his unwavering commitment to God. In Christianity, Avraham is celebrated as a forefather of faith and is recognized for his role in the lineage of Jesus Christ. Despite its ancient origins, the name Avraham continues to appeal to parents seeking a strong and meaningful name for their son.

faq.a: Avraham is a Hebrew name that translates to 'father of many'.
Yes, Avraham is a name of Hebrew origin that is celebrated in Christianity as a forefather of faith.

While Avraham may not be as common as some other names, it continues to hold a significant place in both Judaism and Christianity and is cherished by parents seeking a meaningful and spiritual name for their son.
